- ![](https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/tagr-prod.appspot.com/o/notespace%2Fniar.oel%40gmail.com%2Fuploads%2F2025-03-24T23%3A54%3A58.356Z-image.png?alt=media&token=56453f20-c00a-4484-8810-4a69868abb8f)
- aulē = patio central
  - Estructura
    - Patio cuadrangular o rectangular descubierto de 5x5 a 8x8 m2
    - suelo de tierra apisonada o enlosado con piedra caliza en casas pudientes
    - preferentemente hacia el sur para maximizar luz solar
  - Elementos Centrales
    - bōmós = altar para [Zeus Herkeios = Zeus del Patio](entes:zeus-herkeios)
      - estructura cuadrangular de piedra caliza o marmol pentelico, de 60 a 80cm de altura
    - elaia = olivo sagrado, posiblemente con perimetro delimitado
    - instrumentos sacrificiales como el pélekys = hacha y máxaira = cuchillo
  - Elementos Funcionales
    - pozo o cisterna = estructura circular con brocal de piedra para recoleccion de agua pluvial
    - portico periptero parcial = columnas doricas sencillas sosteniendo techado en uno o dos lados del patio
    - banco perimetral = asiento corrido de peidra adosado a un muro
    - altar portatil secundario = paral ibaciones menores y ofrendas cotidianas
  - Decorativos
    - hermas =  pilares con cabeza y falo de hermes, marcando transiciones espaciales
    - pinturas murales = decoracion en tonos terrosos con motivos geometricos en la parte inferior de los muros
    - nichos voticos = pequeñas hornacinas para ofrendas menores a deidades tutelares
  - Ambiente
    - utilaje agricola, elementos vegetales, animales domesticos,
  - Prompt
    - Arquitectonico
      - "4th century BCE Athenian aule (courtyard), architectural perspective with accurate spatial proportions, limestone-paved open courtyard, quadrangular Zeus Herkeios altar center, sacrificial implements (pelekys axe, machaira knife), partial Doric colonnade with shadow play, cistern with stone rim, sacred olive tree with protective boundary markers, wall niches with household deities, terracotta containers, textural contrast between rough and finished surfaces, archaeological accuracy, photorealistic rendering" --ar 16:9 --style raw --q 2
    - Religioso
      - "Zeus Herkeios domestic worship in 4th century BCE Athenian courtyard, ritual scene, kyrios performing sacrifice at limestone altar, sacred olive adjacent, blood libation vessels, ritual axe and knife prominently displayed, wreath offerings, purification water basin, architectural historically accurate setting, warm Mediterranean light filtering through partial colonnaded roof, household members observing from periphery, photorealistic archaeological reconstruction" --ar 16:9 --style raw --q 2
    - Funcional
      - "Daily life in 4th century BCE Athenian aule (courtyard), domestic activities around Zeus Herkeios altar and sacred olive, household members preparing ritual materials, women carrying water from courtyard well, children with domestic animals, workmen repairing bench seating, storage amphorae against walls, household tools visible, dappled sunlight through olive branches, historically accurate clothing and objects, photorealistic archaeological visualization" --ar 16:9 --style raw --q 2
    - Atmosferico
      - "Late afternoon in 4th century BCE Athenian oikos courtyard, Zeus Herkeios altar catching golden hour light, sacred olive casting elongated shadows across limestone pavers, ritual implements gleaming on altar surface, herma with offerings at threshold, incense smoke drifting through colonnade, water reflections from cistern, visible urban context beyond walls, empty ceremonial space with signs of recent ritual use, highly detailed archaeological reconstruction" --ar 16:9 --style raw --q 2
    - Comparativo
      - "Contrasting wealthy versus modest 4th century BCE Athenian aule (courtyard) split image, aristocratic version with marble Zeus Herkeios altar, elaborate frescoes, extensive colonnade, intricate mosaic floor, multiple sacred plantings versus modest version with simple limestone altar, earthen floor, minimal decoration, functional well, single sacred olive, both historically accurate with period-correct ritual implements, photorealistic archaeological reconstruction" --ar 16:9 --style raw --q 2
    - Custom
      - photorealistic rendering of a classical greece scene of domestic activities around a courtyard  in the center of an oikos containing a holy tree, a simple stone squared altar and a stone cistern. A partial wooden colonnade with shadow play around, Compacted earth floor besides a sacred olive tree with protective boundary markers, sacrificial implements hung on a wall like an axe and a knife, a cistern with stone rim and wall niches with frescoes in the inferior zone of the walls, terracotta containers and a textural contrast between rough and finished surfaces.
- [Greek Popular Religion, by Martin P. Nilsson, [1940], at sacred-texts.com](tana:1ZVFk1Iqkuyc)
